_comment: 085: the start deals. After the assembly bay, three fixers each offer one deal: a gift now and a cost for the run, both shown in full, or WALK ON (no gift, no cost). `RunSetup.roll_deals` picks the three from the run seed alone: one `soft` deal (small gift, small cost) and `offer - 1` others, so a seed code, the daily and the weekly always offer the same three. `give`: scrap, max_hp (every machine), free_level (the next level bought is free; its perk offer is `take.perk_cards` cards), scout_act (every site of the act), rare_arm (a rare arm of the crew's most common maker on the weakest arm socket, the old arm into the hold), module_pick (a pick of that many uncommon modules), swap_arm (a random fitted arm becomes a random uncommon, the old arm gone). `take`: adds (`{path, delta|set[, acts]}` on top of every act, as a rung's; `acts` limits one), elite_first (that many next fights: a skirmish among them is an elite), elite_each_act (as many again at the start of every later act), thin_salvage (that many won fights show `thin_to` salvage parts; unused since the user's 2026-10-29 answer). Every cost is a run rule the map or the HUD shows (`RunSim.active_costs`). The order of `deals` is the run bot's taste (RunBot.deals = "best" takes the first on offer). The user (2026-10-29): costs must bite a forward player too; each deal aims near even for the bot (paired vs WALK ON within about -5..+5), the soft one small both ways. The user (2026-10-30): every cost lasts the whole run, all three acts.

deals.gift: A rare arm of your crew's maker, fitted now
deals.cost: The Reclaimer runs one column ahead, and one of its drones joins every fight
Workshops only where the road guarantees one (two an act)

deals.gift: An uncommon module of your choice (1 of 3)
deals.cost: Salvage shows 2 parts, not 3, and enemies carry 1 more HP
The first two fights of every act are elites

deals.gift: A free level on one machine
deals.cost: That level's perk offer is 2 cards, and skirmishes pay 3 scrap less

deals.gift: One starter arm becomes a random uncommon
deals.cost: You do not choose which arm, and enemies carry 1 more HP
